Commentary.Commentary: Misbah and Younis are greeted with a memento and now the skipper gets his hands on what he and his nation have been trying to do since ages - The Test Series Trophy in the Caribbean! The Pakistan team pose for the photographs and that wraps up the formalities from this emotional Test match. Pakistan win the ODIs, T20Is and now even Tests, incredible show from them. We hope you have enjoyed our coverage. Keep joining us for future games. For now, we gotta go. Goodnight! Take Care! Cheers! Have a great week ahead, folks!

Man of the Series, Yasir Shah thanks the Almighty first up. Informs he was trying to bowl just one good ball that will change the result and is happy to do that. Adds he's really elated to scalp 25 wickets in the series for the first time ever. Further says he bowls with a lot of patience in Tests. Ends by saying there wasn't much pressure on him as the wicket assisted him with turn and bounce although it was slow.

(One last time) Pakistan skipper, Misbah-ul-Haq says he wants to thank the Almighty first up. Mentions whatever success he had in his career is because of the Almighty. Wants to thank his wife and his sister for supporting him throughout. Says she (his sister) convinced him and the fans that he has to go out with a bang. States his son has his exams so he couldn't be there, but says he misses him. Thanks everybody who supported him and prayed for him throughout his career. Adds all things except the Almighty must come to an end. Reckons he couldn't have asked for a better ending to his career. Says the way the guys gave him and Younis Khan a send-off was exceptional. Applauds Younis Khan for having a remarkable career and is grateful for his contribution, especially in the middle. Is thankful that his name will come alongside him in the history books. Admits it's difficult when the game ends just an over before. Goes on to say both teams were under pressure but finally they managed to win that and such wins are more savoury than straightforward wins. Further adds the bowlers bowled their hearts out, especially the seamers. Praises Yasir Shah in particular, who was simply outstanding in bowling long spells. Let's the viewers know that everybody was motivated as it was a chance to win their first ever series in the Caribbean and also as they wanted to do it for him and Younis Khan. Mentions family is important, and so are the fans. Appreciates his mother as well, who is just priceless and says that her prayers and endless support means the world to him. Ends by once again thanking everybody who helped him in his career achieve success.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder is very proud of the fight that his team has showed. Is a bit disappointed with the end result but opines his team has showed the world something that they haven't seen with West Indies cricket for a long time. Adds Pakistan is a tough opposition and feels if they are given a chance to play against tough nations, they can come forward. Appreciates Roston Chase and even Shannon Gabriel for almost digging it out. Feels there's still lot of room for improvement and hopes to improve with each passing game. Ends by congratulating Misbah-ul-Haq and Younis Khan and wishes them all the best for future endeavors.

Man of the Match, Roston Chase says he just wanted to save the Test match, didn't think about his hundred or anything, just wanted to save the match. He adds he just told the others to trust their defense and try hard. Hopes Shannon Gabriel will learn from this experience and not repeat the same mistake next time. Mentions he had a good series but he wants to do even better as it wasn't enough for his team.

This is Pakistan's first ever series win in the Caribbean. Misbah-ul-Haq has done what no other Pakistan captain has ever done before. He bows out to the game in the best possible manner imaginable. He, along with Younis Khan, can leave on a high note. Two stalwarts, true professionals, two fabled careers, two extraordinary gentlemen, two selfless cricketers, two legends in every sense of the word... sign off with a blaze of glory. Remarkable scenes!

The chase was never about winning, but saving the match. Everybody started falling. The hosts needed a Roston Chase special to get something out of this, they got a Roston Chase special which almost took them over the line. He played one of the finest Test knocks in recent years but couldn't get his team over the line. Was almost there, with just 6 balls remaining, but it just wasn't enough. Not sure what he must be thinking now, looking at Gabriel playing that shot. You've got to feel for him.

The first three days of the Test didn't produce much, but the 4th and 5th days had it all. Excitement, drama, heroics, missed chances. It all began with Pakistan posting a good first innings total of 376 led by an Azhar Ali ton. Then West Indies got bundled out for less than 250 where Mohammad Abbas ran riot with his maiden 5-fer. Then West Indies came out and cleaned Pakistan up rather quickly and had a target of 304 in front of them.

Spare a thought for Roston Chase! Heavens know what he must be feeling right now, heartbreaking! He remains stranded on a 101. Dragged his team till the very last minute only to witness his efforts being undone just before the finish line. Either way, this has been a spectacular Test match. The perfect end to this enthralling series.

OUT! No, he can't! Bowled 'em! Yasir Shah has done it with his 11th Test 5-fer! First ever Test series win for Pakistan in the Caribbean! And boy, what a dramatic way to achieve it! Amazing scenes here in Dominica! Yasir Shah is off for a celebratory run and then slides as all his mates come barging towards him. Misbah and Younis punch the air in joy and then there is Roston Chase at the other end left stranded. What must he be going through right now! Coming to the ball, Yasir Shah bowls a quicker full delivery outside off, with everyone closing in, Shannon Gabriel could have defended or even left it, but he takes a risky step. Decides to slog it over the top but ends up getting an inside edge which cannons onto the stumps. PAKISTAN WIN BY 101 RUNS!
The Pakistan players are tensed. But Misbah as always, as he has done throughout his career, keeps smiling. The entire visiting side has closed in around the batsman.
Gabriel takes a long stride forward and keeps it out. Can he survive?

NOT OUT! Shannon Gabriel survives! Bowls a loopy delivery outside leg, it turns in as Gabriel looks to defend. The ball goes off something and it's taken at silly point. Pakistan appeal and it's given out straightaway. Gabriel takes the review and replays show the sound was of the bat being thudded into the pads.
A review! Oh, dear lord... What's happening here? Shannon Gabriel is given out for a bat-pad at silly point. He's reviewed the decision.
Comes from around the wicket and serves a loopy leg spinner around leg, Gabriel turns it past short leg.
It's drizzling! All happening out there at Windsor Park.
Short and turns away, Gabriel goes back and pushes it away on the off side.
Bowls it slower through the air around off, Gabriel doesn't even let it pitch. He blocks it out.
Stays on the back foot and defends it down on the pitch. West Indies have to survive another 12 balls!
Short and on middle and leg, Chase lets it sail over him to the keeper.
Amir goes wide of the crease and angles in a short ball, Chase hops to fend it away as the ball goes past short leg. Yasir Shah from square leg gets to the ball quickly.
Fuller on off, angling in, Chase off the front foot pushes it towards Misbah at short cover.
On a length and outside off, Chase with an open face pushes it towards point.
Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Chase ducks under it.
The last three overs to go. 9 minutes left to play. Roston Chase to face Mohammad Amir. It's really going down to the wire.

An appeal for bat first! Yasir Shah tosses it up around middle and off, Gabriel takes a stride forward and defends it with his bat really close to the pad. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Shannon Gabriel survives! West Indies dressing room is all smiles. This is brilliant!
Not sure what's going to happen here...
A leg slip, a short cover in place along with three slips...
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and some width given, Gabriel slaps it towards point where Azhar Ali makes a fine stop.
Slider around middle and leg, Shannon Gabriel keeps it out.
Once again this one turns away from a length, Gabriel is beaten off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, it turns away as Gabriel is beaten on the front foot defense.
What was that? What is Chase thinking here? Last ball of the over, it's fuller and outside off, he shoulders his arms. Gives Gabriel an entire over now.
Tries the yorker but serves a low full toss, which dips in, Roston Chase bends low and squeezes it out towards short cover.
Fuller and a bit too straight on the pads, Chase works it towards mid-wicket.
Fires in a perfect yorker on the stumps, Chase manages to keep it at bay.
Angles in a well-directed bouncer, Chase ducks under it.
Length ball, with a bit of bounce, Chase lifts his bat to let it be.
Mohammad Amir to bowl again. Will he be the one to get the job done for his team?
Chase will keep strike! Flat and short outside off, Chase slaps it past cover-point and takes the much-needed single.
Beaten! A loopy leg break around middle, it turns away as Chase comes forward to defend. Is beaten all ends up.
Floats it up around off, Roston prods forward in defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mohammad Amir is seen warming up...
Slower one around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on by clearing his front leg.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended into the ground.
Angles another length delivery, Gabriel is a bit late to sway away from the line and almost kisses this one to the keeper.

FOUR! Edged and over the slip cordon! Ali goes around the wicket and angles away a back of a length delivery, Gabriel doesn't want to play but hangs his bat around. The ball goes off the outside edge and evades a leaping third slip fielder for a boundary. Ooohss and Aaahsssss around the stadium.
Keeps it straight on the stumps, Shannon offers a straight bat defense.
Prods forward and across and defends it down.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Gabriel ducks almost instantly under it.
Fuller in length and just outside off, Gabriel defends it off the front foot.
Bowls a slider outside off, Roston Chase mistimes his drive towards covers. Is fumed at himself as he will be off strike.
Stays back and punches it down the wicket.
Floats it up around middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
Leg break outside off, Chase leaves it alone.
Slider around off, left alone.
Good length ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! The decision stands! The buzz around the stadium as Gabriel survives! Ali goes wide of the crease and angles in a full length delivery, it keeps coming as Shannon has a tame push inside the line and Sarfraz behind the stumps collects and Pakistan go up in an appeal. The umpire turns it down. Pakistan take the review as there was some noise as the ball went past the bat. After seeing a lot of replays the TV umpire isn't convinced either. There is no Snicko or Ultra Edge either. He stays with the on-field call.
A review! Could this be it? Pakistan have taken a review for a caught behind decision against Shannon Gabriel.
Two slips, a gully, a short leg, a short cover and short mid-wicket in place.
Fractionally fuller and around off, Gabriel pushes it towards covers.
Good length delivery, served outside off, Gabriel shoulders his arms.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in! 52 balls still left in the day. Can West Indies survive?

OUT! Wicket for Pakistan! Oh, how it couldn't have come any sooner! Hasan Ali with an absolute gem. Bowls it on a back of a length in the corridor of uncertainty, makes Alzarri Joseph play at it. Draws the edge and it's a simple take for Sarfraz Ahmed behind the stumps. Not a no ball this time, the wicket will stay. The pacer gets down one his knees and rejoices as his teammates charge towards him to celebrate. They're just 1 wicket away from their first series win in the Caribbean.
Full from Hasan Ali, it's nice and straight on middle and off, Joseph drives it towards short cover off the outer half.
Extremely loopy on the stumps, Chase makes room and drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Too full and too straight, defended.
Quicker one around off, goes back and punches it to the cover-point fielder.
Loopy but it's too straight, Chase easily deals with it.
Quite full, Joseph drives it through the covers and just takes one. Brings Roston Chase on strike.
Tossed up delivery outside off, spins away and beats the outside edge of Joseph's bat.
Hurls it on a length and this one straightens a bit, Chase off the outer part of the bat keeps it out on the off side.
Good length delivery on off, Chase once again lets it be.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Chase leaves it alone.
Drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Shortish on off, blocked to point.
3rd Test century for Roston Chase!

FOUR! Take a bow, Roston Chase! Whadddaaaaaaplayer! He reaches to his ton in grand fashion and gets the Dominica crowd right behind him. He has consumed over 200 balls and still looks strong. He's made a habit of saving Tests or what? Did one against the No. 1 Test team, India and is almost nearing against another Asian Giant. Coming to the ball, fuller and angling in, Chase flicks it with pure timing past mid on for a boundary. Removes the helmet and crosses his hands towards the dressing room. What does it mean? The X-Factor? Nevertheless, the job isn't done yet, still over 10 more overs left after this. Can he do it?
Hasan Ali returns.
A bit too short on middle and off, it's defended off the back foot.
Pitches it outside off, it turns away, AJ leaves it alone.

Beaten! That's where the experience of Yasir comes out! Lures the tailender with a loopy leg break and asks him to go after him. Joseph shows no maturity and goes for a wild swing across the line. The ball turns away and whizzes past the outside edge. Yasir Shah wears a wry smile.
Loopy leg break, it turns away, Joseph doesn't play at those.
Very full on the stumps, the batsman digs it out comfortably.
Bowls a loopy delivery outside off, Alzarri defends it off the back foot.
Yasir Shah is brought back into the attack. Roston Chase on 96, the leggie one short of a 5-fer. Going to be an interesting battle.
Fullish on off, Chase drives it hard but straight to the cover fielder.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller and comes back in, stays low as well. Chase bends low to counter this but gets an outside edge which rolls down to third man.
Bowls it on a back of a length, Chase gets on top of the bounce and taps it towards the off side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chase watches it till the last minute and then shoulders his arms.
Fuller and angling in on middle, driven towards mid on by shuffling across.
Goes to over the wicket for the last ball of the over. Keeps it a bit short, Joseph punches it towards point where the fielder dives to stop it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Serves it full from around the wicket, a tight defense is on offer. Amir gives a stare!
Fuller on off, a nice drive from Joseph straight to cover.
Bowls it a bit wide outside off, AJ leaves it alone.

Goodness me! I can't believe how did that miss the stumps? Amir goes wide of the crease and bowls an inswinger. It keeps coming in with the angle as Joseph offers no stroke. The ball goes off the pads and just over the stumps. Mighty close that!

FOUR! Lovely hit! Every time Chase scores a boundary, Abbas will be hurt! Length delivery outside off, Chase stands tall and punches it firmly through covers for a boundary. On 96 now! The crowd is up on its feet!
Fuller and keeps it on middle, Chase prods forward and defends it with his bat close to pad.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Roston ducks under it.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, Chase stays back and defends.
Sprays it full and wide outside off, Chase reaches out and drives it towards covers.
Strays down the leg side, Chase has got nothing to offer. Sarfraz dives to his left to stop it but fails to do so. They don't take a bye.
Drinks have been taken! Minimum 15 overs have to be bowled, but the time can be extended by half an hour, which is 1800 local time.
Yes, he does! Fuller and angling in on off, AJ defends it off the front foot.
Comes from around the wicket and gets it to nip back in from around off, Alzarri looks to drive but is lucky to get some part of the bat involved there. Can Alzarri survive on the last ball?
Keeps it on the stumps, it's defended down solidly.
Very full on leg, Joseph misses the flick and the ball goes towards short leg.
Comes in from around off, Joseph gets beaten and wears it on the thigh pad.
Wayward! Sprays down the leg side, Alzarri goes after it but fails to get any wood on it.
Mohammad Amir will try his luck with the new ball.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Good length delivery, it comes in and Chase is opened up a bit. Gets a leading edge which goes towards point.
Doesn't even look at this delivery which is outside off.

WICKET OFF A NO BALL! Roston Chase gets a third life! Oh dear, Abbas has overstepped just by a margin and that's enough to cut down all the celebrations. Bowls a lovely outswinger and Chase who was mentally so strong goes for a lazy drive through the off side. Gets an outside edge and Asad Shafiq at first slip takes a sharp catch. They start to appeal, Misbah was so happy I can't tell you but unfortunately, Abbas oversteps. End of story! Chase is still there and so are the Windies' hopes.
Once again it swings away, Chase allows it to be.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase punches it towards the cover fielder.
Swing straightaway! Bowls it on a length, it swings away, Chase leaves it alone.
The second new ball is available and Pakistan have taken it. The reviews have been refreshed too.

A loud, loud shout for an LBW! Very full and swinging back in on middle and leg, Joseph is late to bring his bat down and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire turns it down. Seemed like there were two sounds. Replays show it wouldn't have had mattered as the ball was going on to miss the stumps.
Served on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Ali hurls a length ball on off, it kicks off the deck. Chase looks to defend but his bottom hand comes off and gets hit on the glove.
Fuller and gets it to nip back in, Chase comes forward to defend but the ball takes an inside edge and goes past the vacant short leg region.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards the cover region.
Fuller outside off, Chase drives it off the front foot towards covers.
Cutter on off, very full as AJ defends it towards mid off.
Fuller on off, Joseph defends it off the front foot.
Sprays down the leg side, Joseph tries flicking it but fails to do so.
Fuller on off, blocked.
That was a brave leave! Abbas serves it outside off, it comes back in sharply as Joseph doesn't play at it. The ball almost, almost kisses the off pole. Pakistan can't believe it.

That's a beamer! Mohammad Abbas gets a warning for that and he says sorry to Joseph as well. Tries to bowl a yorker but the ball seems to have slipped out of his hands and Alzarri takes evasive action to duck under it. Could have been nasty.
Short on middle and leg, Joseph ducks under it.
Cutter on off, Roston Chase defends it off the front foot.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Chase looks to swipe it wildly across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal is made but it was cent percent going down leg.

In the air... dropped! But that was a really tough chance! Angles in a full length delivery, Chase drills it back to the bowler who tries to take it in his followthrough but the ball comes like a rocket to him and bursts off his fingers to mid off. Ali then falls down on the ground and seems to have hurt his right shoulder as well. Chase survives again.
A low full, which dips in on off, Chase crouches low and defends it down.
Very full and tailing back in, Chase drives it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery, moving away outside off, Chase punches it towards Misbah at short cover.
Good length delivery on off, solidly defended to end the over.

FOUR! Full and angling down, Joseph flicks it fine down the leg side. Goes past the diving keeper and away to the fence. Pakistan don't care though, these are positive signs for them. They'll welcome it gladly.
Alzarri Joseph is the new man in!

OUT! ABBAS WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! How much Pakistan needed that. Excellent short ball on middle and leg, from around the wicket, Bishoo doesn't know what to do with this one. Awkwardly plays at it and the ball goes off the handle of the bat. Lobs to Shan Masood at silly point who takes a dolly. The visitors have finally broken this frustrating stand, this is what they were looking for for so long. The visiting team is just 2 wickets away from victory here.
Short ball angling in on middle and off, the left-hander ducks and just about evades.
Another full delivery just outside off, straightening up, Bishoo pushes it in front of covers.
Fullish length delivery wide outside off, Devendra Bishoo pushes it away to short cover.
Fuller in length and swinging back in, takes a big stride forward and drives it to mid off.
Roaring shout for an lbw! That looked close. Hasan Ali curls this back into the batsman, raps Roston Chase on the pads. The umpire isn't interested, probably height was the issue.
High full toss on middle and leg, worked straight to short mid-wicket.

Roston Chase has coped a blow off the inside edge on his left ankle. The physio is out there to assist him. He looks in some pain out there. He got retired out in the first innings as well but his team can't afford the same now. They need him to stay and stay as long as possible. Okay, so Chase is fine and is ready to continue...

Ouch... That must have hurt! Full and on the stumps, Chase looks to slog across the line but the ball strikes him on the inside of the left ankle. Goes down and calls for medical attention straightaway.
Length delivery skidding off the surface, keeps a bit low as Chase just about manages to keep it out.
Full and tailing back in, going for the yorker as Chase hangs back and keeps it out.
Change of ends for Hasan Ali.
Similar ball, play and a miss.
Outside off on a back of a length, Bishoo looks to feel for it but is beaten. Almost nicked it there.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Bishoo looks to fend it away awkwardly but it goes off his armguard. It lobs behind as the keeper takes it. Stifled appeal but the umpire doesn't bother with it.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On an good length, outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Over the wicket, floated around off, turns it as Bishoo defends.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side.
Spinning down leg, works this one past leg slip.
Full on the stumps, whipped hard to mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
Tossed up outside off, kept out off the front foot.
Looped up on middle and off, worked to the short leg fielder for no run.
Fuller and angling in, Chase works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Roston Chase cuts it beautifully between point and gully for a boundary. Into the 90s now!
Lunges forward and pushes it towards covers.
Fuller and it curls back in from outside the line, so no harm for Chase.
Back of a length outside off, angling in, Roston punches it off the back foot towards point.
Starts off with a length ball on off, it stays a bit low as Chase defends it down safely.
Mohammad Abbas comes back into the attack now.
Short and angling down, Bishoo pulls it fine down the leg side. Gets a couple of runs for doing so. Well played.
Looped up well outside off, gets to the pitch and drives to wide mid off.
Easily played. Brings his wrists into play and turns it past FSL.
Full and straight from Yasir, pushed back down the track easily.
Sharp spin in, goes off the pads as Devendra Bishoo looks to flick. It goes past leg slip but no run is taken.
Tossed up from around the wicket, Bishoo comes forward and flicks it to short mid-wicket.

Drinks break! Pakistan need to be a bit more aggressive here. Their field placements are very defensive which is allowing Roston Chase to play with utmost ease. Need to attack him more, otherwise he'll keep doing what he's doing and see the day out.
Angling in on middle and off, blocked.
Comfortably played with time to spare. Solid batting from Roston Chase. Just taps it to short extra cover.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase stands tall and punches it along the ground through the covers. The fielders chase it down as the batsmen take two runs.
Full and slower on middle and leg,Chase brings his bat ahead of his pad and defends solidly.
Angles it in on middle and leg, continuing from around the wicket, flicked in front of the short leg fielder.
Wide! Short and angling down, Roston stays still and lets it go. Wide called though, for height it seems.
Full toss outside off, pushed away to the covers for a couple.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Presses forward to this full ball and defends.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Heavy spin into the southpaw once more, worked away to the leg side.
Turning in sharply from around off, Bishoo goes back and blocks it down on the track.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up outside off, Devendra plants his front foot across and pushes it square on the off side.
Comes forward to this one and blocks it out solidly.
Roston Chase has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery around the off stump line, gets behind the line and defends.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good length ball around off, leans ahead a touch and pushes it to the cover area.
Starts off from around the wicket, comes from wide of the crease and angles it in on off, kept out from within the crease.
Mohammad Amir returns to the bowling attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
High full toss on off, defended. Hasan Ali instantly apologizes for it, signals that the ball slipped out of his hands.
On the shorter side of the length, slower in pace, Bishoo plays at this very late. Dabs it down in front of the slip cordon.
Pounds it in on a back of a length, on off, gets behind the line and defends it down on the off side with a straight bat.
Makes it go away on a full length, Bishoo initially tries to play but then withdraws from the shot.
Beaten! An excellent delivery in the channel around off, straightens after pitching, Bishoo looks to play inside the line but can't connect.
Loopy ball full on the pads, looks to sweep it away but it goes off this boot.
Short and down the leg side, Chase looks to pull it fine down the leg side. Misses and so does Sarfraz. It goes behind and the batsmen take two runs. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Quicker one on the stumps, Roston Chase hangs back and punches it a bit square towards cover-point.
Drops it on a length this, it's turning away and Chase once again leaves it alone.
Outside off, on a shorter length, left alone.
Flat, short and turning, Chase has nothing to do with it.
Arrows across a full delivery, well outside off, Bishoo reaches out to it and gets some bat on it. It goes behind but falls short of the diving second slip fielder.
Full and slower on middle and off, tries to deceive the tailender but he doesn't fall into the trap. Leans ahead and blocks.
Over the wicket now, it's short and on leg, the left-hander ducks and evades.
High full toss on the stumps, with a perfectly straight bat Devendra Bishoo blocks it back down the ground towards mid on.
Full and angling in, swinging away at the last second, Bishoo reaches out to it and pushes it away to point.
Short of a good length outside off, Devendra rises and does well to keep it down on the ground on the off side.
FOUR! Two in two for Chase! He stands tall and hoicks it over wide mid on to end the over with a boundary. He's really taking it to the Pakistan bowlers here now.

FOUR! He's a beauty, this fellow Chase! What a shot. Short, flat and turning away, Roston Chase rocks back and cuts this fiercely through cover-point. No chance for anybody to stop that as the ball races away to the fence.
Darts it quite full on middle and leg, once again it's played back to the bowler.
Full outside off, pushes straight to the man at short extra cover.
Lands this a little behind, on middle and off, Chase presses ahead and blocks.
Too full on middle and leg, Roston clears his front leg and drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish in length, outside off, Devendra Bishoo prods forward in defense and gets an outside edge towards gully.
Angles it in on a back of a length, on off, Bishoo gets behind the line and defends it down.
Fires it full and well outside off, straightens up after pitching, Bishoo leaves it alone.
Switches the angle and comes from around the wicket, bowls a full toss on off, Bishoo with no foot movement pushes it to the cover region.
Full and angling in on the pads, clipped through to backward square leg for one run.
Drops this in front of covers and sets off. Both batsmen are quick so they beat the throw at the keeper's end.
Tossed up leg spinner outside off, too full which allows Bishoo to drive it through the covers for a run.
FOUR BYES! From around the wicket, spins down the leg side and beats everybody. It races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Full outside off, driven to covers for a single.
Spinning away on a full length, outside off, pushed away square to cover-point.
Tossed up around off, Chase drills it to the covers for nothing.
Devendra Bishoo walks in next!

OUT! Hasan Ali strikes! Three reds and Jason Holder is gone. There was daylight between the inside edge and the ball, the Windies skipper has to walk back. A full toss which swings back in sharply and pings Holder on the back pad who is a tad late to bring his bat down. Loud appeal to which the umpire raises his finger. Jason quickly takes the review and replays show he's gone on all counts. Hasan Ali missed out on Chase, but has gotten Holder. Pakistan have a wicket early after the break, can they run through the tail from here?
Jason Holder is adjudged LBW off a full toss. The skipper takes the review. Looks plumb! Only inside edge can save him...
On a length, around off, kept out from within the crease.
Angling back in on leg, Holder works it off his pads square on the leg side.
Very full outside off, Chase leans ahead and drills it through the covers. The fielder chases it down and keeps the batsmen to one.
Angling in on middle and leg, worked in front of short mid-wicket. No run taken.
Hurls a length ball in the channel outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Loopy outside leg, Holder prods forward to defend but gets an outside edge which falls short of the man at first slip.
Drops it short on middle and leg, Roston rocks back and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single. 150 up for the Windies!
Turning in from outside leg, has a bit of bounce as Roston off the back foot cuts it behind point. Two runs taken.
Goes deep in the crease and defends it off the back foot.

A shout for a catch! Nothing from the umpire! Tossed up delivery, outside leg, turning in as Chase comes forward to defend. The ball goes off his pads and Younis Khan at first slip dives forward to his left and takes it. Yasir Shah appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Replays confirm it went off the pads.
Tossed up on leg, Chase looks to sweep but then at the last minute he allows it to go through.
Yasir Shah will bowl from the other end.
This one tails back in sharply, Jason flicks it through square leg.
Shortish outside off, Holder stays back to keep it out.
Fuller and swinging back in, worked through mid on for a single.

DROPPED! Hasan Ali shells a simple return catch! Serves a good length delivery, it stops on the batsman as Chase looks to defend. He ends up chipping it straight back to the bowler who tries to take it to his right in his followthrough but the ball doesn't stick. Well, well, well, Chase survives a scare here!
Good length delivery, Chase looks to poke at it with soft hands means that the outside edge doesn't carry to the gully fielder.
On a length and around middle, Chase defends it off the back foot.

Back for the final session of this 3rd Test. Will this pair of Holder and Chase continue to dig it out? Or will the visitors wrap it up. 38 overs still remaining in the day. Let's hope for a cracking end to the series. Hasan Ali to start off with the bowling proceedings. Here we go!!!
... FINAL DAY, FINAL SESSION ...

A good session for West Indies. They've put up a good fight and dragged this to the last session of the day. The hosts lost two wickets early in the second session but since then, Roston Chase and Jason Holder have steadied things up nicely with the former scoring a fifty, being as reliable as ever. A lot rides on this current pair. The Pakistan bowlers were made to toil hard, and will face similar circumstances. But breaking this partnership could see them make inroads. The break could work in their favour. Join us in a bit for the final session of this Test match.
Fuller on middle, Jason Holder blocks it down. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 5!
Loopy full toss around middle, Holder drives it through extra cover for a couple.
Stays back and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Bowls it with a round arm action, Chase blocks it solidly.
50-run stand between Chase and Holder!

FOUR! That's muscled! Shafiq drops it short outside leg, Chase rocks back quickly and pulls it with utmost disdain through square leg for a boundary. The short leg fielder did well there to take evasive action.
Comes from around the wicket and loops it up around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it on middle, turning away, Chase doesn't feel for it.
Flattish through the air around middle, flicked off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Blocked off the front foot and into the ground.
Gives it a bit more flight around middle and off, Holder comes forward and looks to defend it off the front foot with soft hands but gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce to first slip.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Holder prods forward to keep it out.
Pushes it quicker through the air around middle, Holder goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery around middle, Roston Chase milks it down to long on to get to the other end.
Fuller on middle and leg, Chase digs it out on the leg side.
FOUR! Asad Shafiq tosses it up outside off, it grips and turns in, Chase rocks back and crunches it through covers. Superb hit!
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Drifting in from around off, Holder lunges forward and defends it down on the track.
Asad Shafiq is now having a go with the ball. Pakistan trying everything here to get a wicket before the break.
Bowls a full toss around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air... safe! Slows it through the air and lands it around off, it turns away as Chase pulls out of the cut shot at the last minute. He gets a top edge which falls safely near the backward point region. A single taken.
Flat and turning away from a length, Chase pushes it towards covers.
Lands it around off, it turns away, Roston Chase leaves it alone.
Loopy ball outside off, Chase makes room and drives it towards mid off.
Tossed up delivery around off, Chase lunges forward and defends it down.
Azhar Ali is brought into the attack.
FOUR! That's whacked! On a length and outside off, gives a bit of width on it as Jason Holder triggers it through covers for a boundary to end the over. The crowd loves it!
Fuller outside off, Holder leans into it and drives it towards the cover fielder.
Goes back and punches it towards short cover this time.
Good length delivery outside off, Holder defends it by getting right behind it.
Bowls a cutter, very full outside off, Jason Holder jams it out towards covers.
Serves a length delivery outside off, Holder allows it to go through to the keeper.
Overpitches it around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Holder makes room and drives it towards covers.
Googly around middle and leg, Chase picks it up and flicks it off the back foot through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy full toss around middle, Chase isn't tempted by it. He pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and turning in from around leg, Chase rocks back and hits it through covers to collect two.
Outside leg, Chase lunges forward and kills the spin by padding away.
Back of a length delivery, tucked towards the on side by shuffling across.
Short and going down leg, Holder was looking to go after it but then at the last moment he moves inside the line to leave it alone.
Makes Holder go after a length ball on off, The Windies skipper almost falls in the trap and is lucky as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
This time the ball shapes away, Holder doesn't play at it.
Fuller and curling back in, Jason lunges forward and keeps it out.
Good length delivery outside off, it stays a bit low and Holder has no harm in defending it down.
Pushes this to the covers and takes a single to end the over.
Pushed quicker through the air, around off, leans across to get behind the line and blocks.
Drops this on a driveable length on off, Holder is forward in defense.
Full on the stumps, clears his front leg and drives it to mid on for one.
Tossed up on the pads, Chase attempts to sweep it away but fails to make connection.
4th Test fifty for Roston Chase!

From around the wicket, spinning away on a shorter length, Roston Chase backs away and cuts it past point. Picks up a couple of runs and brings up his fifty with that. Superb knock, he's looked confident and produced a good knock. He needs to bat on through till the end though. He'll know that.
Marginally ahead of a length, comes half-forward and defends it down safely.
On a length again, in the channel outside off, Holder has nothing to do with that.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Jason Holder stays perfectly behind the line and presents the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Serves it on a length and outside off, Jason Holder leaves it alone.
Good length delivery around off, comes ahead to keep it out.
Mohammad Abbas is back into the attack!
Spinning off the rough and taking some venomous bounce, it kicks off and takes Roston Chase by surprise. He's lucky not to edge that.
From around the wicket now, spinning towards off, Holder comes ahead and pushes it to extra cover for a single.
Goes back and punches it past the vacant silly point position for no run.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Jason adjusts and dead-bats it.
FOUR! Another one which is dropped short, Jason Holder rocks back and hoicks it over mid on. Once he cleared the infield, the ball was always going to go across the rope.
Drops it on a length, outside off, pushed out to the off side off the back foot.
Very full and outside off, reaches out to it and pushes it to point.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Yorker angling in on the stumps, Holder digs it out towards mid on and takes a run.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Short ball banged outside off, Holder ducks and lets it through.
Turning away from outside off, Chase with an angled bat steers it to the cover-point fielder.

FOUR! Clears the infield again. That's a good shot. Short and it's put away. Roston Chase rocks back and heaves it over wide mid on. Doesn't exactly middle it but it's enough to fetch him a boundary. Moves on to 49 with that.
Loopy leg spinner around leg, Roston Chase plants his front foot forward and pads it away.
SIX! Good hit. Clears his front leg, hits it out of the rough and sends it all the way. Slogs it high with the full swing of the bat and clears the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
Tossed up outside leg, Roston pads it away to short leg.
Spinning into the pads from outside leg, Chase goes back and works it behind square on the leg side.
Length ball once more, Holder stays behind the line and keeps it out towards point.
Angling in on a good length on off, Holder meets it with a straight bat.
Just ahead of a length, outside off, pushed through the covers with hard hands for a couple of runs.
Beautiful! Amir once again comes from wide of the crease, creates the angle and gets it to straighten up after hitting the deck. Goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves. Was so close.
On a length and outside off, Holder has a tame push from inside the line but is beaten past the outside edge.
Comes from around the wicket, steams in from wide of the crease and bowls it outside off, Jason Holder lets it be.
Drinks break!
Short, spinning away with some venomous bounce, Chase looks to cut but misses.
Full on middle, Holder looks to work it across the line but gets a leading edge back down the ground for a single.
Full ball which is driven to mid on for a single.
Looped up outside leg, spinning towards off, padded away by the batsman.
Full around leg, Chase clears his front leg and blocks.

Not out! Looped up outside leg, Chase kneels down to sweep it away. It brushes off something as Sarfraz takes the catch. Loudly appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Misbah walks towards his keeper, they talk about it and the review is taken. Replays show it's gone off the pads.
A caught behind decision against Roston Chase is reviewed by Pakistan.
Good looking shot! Amir goes wide of the crease and keeps it fuller outside off. Chase leans into it and drives it excellently through extra cover. Heavy outfield means Chase will get only three.
Angles it on middle, Chase looks to work it away on the leg side but gets a slight inside edge on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller and sprayed outside off, Roston prods forward and pushes it towards covers.
Accurate yorker, angling in, Chase digs it out.
Fuller and it swings away as Chase looks to go after it. Gets beaten.
Fuller outside off, Holder looks to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Slows it through the air, Jason once again is happy to let it be.
The ball turns in a bit but Holder stays on the back foot to defend it down.
Bowls the googly, Holder blocks.
Jason Holder is the new man in!

OUT! The decision stays as it is! The crowd Boos and continue to do that! Yasir Shah loops it up outside leg, on the rough and the ball spins in. Dowrick looks to flick it away as the ball goes off something to Babar Azam at forward short leg who takes the catch. Pakistan appeal and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Dowrich takes the review and the TV umpire sees it from all the angles possible. A puff of dust emerges and it seemed like Dowrich hasn't got any bat on it. No conclusive evidence though as there is no Snicko or Ultra Edge. The third umpire sticks to the on-field call and Shane Dowrich has to depart. 4th wicket for Yasir!
Dowrich is given out caught at short leg. But he takes the review. Is it off the pads?
Pitches it on the rough, it turns in with good bounce as Chase gets back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fires in a yorker on the stumps, Dowrich jams it out towards point.
Very full on off, Dowrich looks to drive it away but gets an outside edge which doesn't carry to the gully fielder.
Short leg is removed and there is a man at silly point now.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls nice and full on middle, Shane looks to work it away on the leg side but gets a safe leading edge towards cover.
Dowrich stays behind the line of this delivery and defends it down on the pitch.
Length ball on middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Chase takes his eyes off the ball at the last moment but still drags the pull in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Mohammad Amir is called back into the attack!
Bowls a bit quicker outside off, Dowrich stomps it off the front foot.
Takes a good stride forward to keep this one out.
Switches to the leg break, around off, the Windies keeper defends it off the front foot.
Picks the wrong 'un again but it was in the air for a while! Goes back and punches it a bit uppishly towards mid-wicket. No one there and he's safe.
Another googly, it's a bit too full, Shane flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Bowls the googly around middle, it turns in, Dowrich reads and as a result goes back to defend.
Short and outside off, slapped straight to the gully fielder.
Short ball zipping off the track, sways inside the line to let it through.
Doesn't move much, lets the ball come to him and defends it down on the track.
Back of a length angling in, kept out off the back foot.
Well played, Roston. This length ball keeps low as it's skidding on middle and off, Chase does well to bring his bat down in time. Gets it off the bottom of the bat onto his boot.

FOUR! That's an excellent shot, especially given the thickness of the outfield. Back of a length outside off, Roston Chase is onto his back foot in a jiffy. Crunches it through point and the ball beats the two chasing fielders.
Some more air, flighted nicely outside off, blocked square on the off side.
Outside off on a fullish length, Shane shoulders his arms to it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Shane presses forward to bury it into the track.
Lands this just back of a driving length, on off, spins a long way away as Dowrich covers the line and leaves it alone.

Short, wide outside off and shooting off the deck, Dowrich rocks back to cut but is no control of that shot. It goes between silly point and first slip which allows the batsmen to take a couple of runs.
Full ball on the pads, worked in front of short leg.
Full on the pads, easily dealt with as it's kept out on the on side.
Good yorker, speared on middle and leg, the batsman does well to dig it out.
Roston camps back to this one and punches it away on the off side.
No ball! Oversteps on this occasion and the umpire calls it a no ball. Full and outside off, blocked.
Back of a length moving across, Chase rises and keeps it down.
Down the leg side, Chase initially thinks about glancing it down fine but then decides against it.

Hasan Ali continues from around the wicket and angles across a back of a length delivery around off, Roston Chase is early into the shot as he pulls it too early. It was the slower one which deceived him.
Short and flat outside off, off his back foot Chase cuts it to covers for a single. Into the hands of the fielder and that'll be the end of the over.
Tossed up ball on off, played straight back to the bowler.
On the shorter side of the length, Roston goes back and whips this through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, cut away straight to the cover-point fielder.
Floats it up around off, comes half-forward and defends.
Top spinner around off, Chase goes back and punches it in front of covers.
Fuller length delivery to end the over, Shane presents a tight defensive shot.
Yorker fired in on middle and leg, tailing back in, Dowrich does well to jam this one out. Nicely done.
Full and swinging back in, on off, Dowrich stands his ground and pushes it back down the track.
Changes the angle and comes from around the wicket, it's short and into the body, Roston rises and fends it away square on the leg side. One run taken.
Shortish delivery way outside off, Chases hops and punches it with an angled bat through cover-point for a double.
Short ball angling in on middle and leg, Roston Chase crouches quite low and lets it go over him.
Comes ahead once more and keeps it out stoutly. Good over from Yasir Shah.
Adjusts well inside the crease, it's a bit straight on middle and leg so Shane Dowrich can keep it out safely.
Turning away from outside off, no trouble for the batsman to let it be.
Pitches it right up there again, around off, Dowrich presses forward and dead-bats it.
Over the wicket to Dowrich, it's tossed up around off, met well with the full face of the bat.
Shane Dowrich is the next batsman in.

OUT! Yasir Shah strikes again! That's a wonderful delivery. Drops it in the rough and gets it to turn in, Vishaul Singh plants his front foot across and looks to defend it with bat and pad kept close together. The ball takes an inside edge, then thuds onto the pads and lobs towards short leg where Babar Azam takes a good catch diving forward. The leggie has his third of the innings.
Short of a length outside off, gets on top of the bounce and dabs it square through point. Runs across and completes two runs.
Keeps a little low as it's shaping in off the deck, on a length this time, Chase does well to bring his bat down in time and work it away in front of mid-wicket.
Over the wicket to the right-hander, Hasan Ali fires it full and makes it swing back in on middle and off, Chase drives it to the mid off fielder.
Angling in on a back of a length, well outside off, Singh taps it to cover-point with an open face and gets a single to his name.
Fuller length ball on off, Singh goes across once more and works it to mid-wicket with a closed face.
Starts off from around the wicket and angles it in from around off, Vishaul Singh moves across a bit and meets it with a straight blade.
Hasan Ali to bowl from the other end.
Kicks off from a shorter length, spinning away, blocked off the back foot.
Flighted ball from Yasir, it's defended off the front foot.
Beaten! Beautiful delivery. Chase goes back to this half-volley and that almost proves to be his undoing. Goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's hands.
Loopy on a fuller length, closer to the off stump this time, Chase lets it be.
Tossed up outside off, it's left alone.

Drama straightaway! Very good start from Yasir Shah. There's a shout for a leg before but it's turned down. It landed outside the line of leg stump, rapped Roston Chase on the pads as he went back to play but the appeal is no to avail. Good decision by the umpire.

We are back for the afternoon session. It will be Roston Chase and Vishaul Singh to shoulder the responsibility of trying to steer their team home. Yasir Shah will start off the second session with the ball.
... FINAL DAY, SECOND SESSION ...

26.3 Overs, 66 Runs and 3 Big Wickets! Needless to say who owns the session! Pakistan were right on the money from the word go and it was Yasir Shah who once again got into the action today morning as he removed a patient Kraigg Brathwaite. Mohammad Amir then got the ball to swing and removed Shimron Hetmyer. And then Hasan Ali and Mohammad Abbas were really disciplined in their approach and got the ball to reverse, with the former scalping his maiden Test wicket in the name of Shai Hope. So, from the looks of things, one would feel Pakistan are inches closer to their first ever Test series win in the Caribbean but only one man can keep them at bay and it's Roston Chase. Join us back in a short while for the afternoon session...
Comes from over the wicket for the last ball and bowls it on a good length outside off, Vishaul Singh defends it gently off the back foot. No drama on the last ball then! LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Fuller on middle, Singh walks across and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Singh leaves it alone.

Edged but safe! Serves it close to the off stump line, Vishaul Singh lunges to defend it down with an angled bat. He does so with soft hands and hence the edge doesn't carry towards the gully fielder.
On a length and once again outside off, the batsman defends it off the back foot comfortably.
Good length delivery on off, Vishaul places himself right behind the line of the delivery and defends it down nicely.

FOUR! Edged and away! Sprays it very full outside off, Chase chases it and gets an outside edge which evades the man at gully and slowly crosses the third man rope. A boundary to end the over. Pakistan won't mind it as Vishaul Singh will be the one who will be facing the last over before lunch.
Full on leg, flicked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Another fumble! Fuller outside off, this time Chase drives it towards Azhar Ali at covers who misfields and they take a couple of runs.

Sloppy from Misbah! Serves it a bit full outside off, Singh pushes it towards Misbah at short cover who fumbles and doesn't charge towards the ball. The batsmen sneak in a quick single as the Pakistan skipper misses the shy at the bowler's end. Singh is off the mark!
Touch short and served on middle, Vishaul Singh keeps it out off the back foot.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a full delivery on middle, Singh does well to keep it at bay.
Fullish on the stumps, Chase blocks it down on the pitch.

NOT OUT! The decision stands! Abbas hurls it on a length outside off, it nips back in to ping Chase on the back leg. They all appeal long and hard but the umpire stays put. Misbah takes the review and replays show it would have gone over the stumps. Pakistan waste a review!
A review for an LBW decision against Roston Chase is taken by Pakistan.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase dabs it towards the gully fielder.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Good length ball, defended in front of FSL.
Fuller in length and outside off, defended off the front foot.
Vishaul Singh to be the new man in.

OUT! Toe-crusher and Hope is out of here! What a delivery to get his maiden Test wicket! He punches the fist, and then does it again and then raises his arms to celebrate. That's a huge wicket! Hasan Ali kept on bowling those full lengths and got the reward! This one curls back in and hits Hope on the boot as he tries to flick. Is undone by the pace and the inward movement and the umpire raises his finger in response to the LBW appeal.
Fuller again and angling in, Hope gets across and closes the face of the bat to push it towards the on side.
Fuller and tries to angle it on middle, Hope lunges forward and bunts it back to the bowler.
Beaten! Serves a full ball, in the channel outside off, Hope looks to drive but the ball stays low and goes under his bat to the keeper. This is good bowling from Hasan Ali.
Fuller in length, keeps it out by walking a step down the pitch.
Fullish in length, Hope walks across the sticks and clips it past the man at short leg.
Gets behind this full length delivery and solidly keeps it out.
Continues to keep it full outside off, Chase drives it towards mid off.
Nips back in from a length outside off, Chase looks to defend but the ball hits him high on the bat and dies down.
Fuller and swinging back in on middle and leg, Chase looks to flick but chips it in the air. Is lucky as the ball falls short of the man at short mid-wicket.
Serves it wide outside off, Roston offers no stroke.
Very full outside off, Chase drives it towards mid off.
Mohammad Abbas comes into the attack, replacing Yasir!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fractionally full, just outside off, Hope blocks it out towards covers.
Outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller and just outside off, Shai Hope has got nothing to with that one.
Touch fuller and outside off, Shai Hope drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller and searching for some swing here, the ball curls back in as Hope digs it out on the leg side.
Yasir Shah is off the field. He's been bowling all morning so probably wants to take a breather. Mohammad Asghar will be taking his place for the time being.
FOUR! Slapped! Short and turning away from outside leg, Chase goes back and slaps it through covers for a boundary to end the over.
Gets low and once again sees it off.
On the rough and it turns away as Chase reaches out to that one and hits it through covers for a brace.
Chase presses forward and keeps it out on the leg side.
Goes deep in the crease and punches it towards the cover fielder.
Tossed up outside leg, Chase blocks it down.

Around the wicket for the last ball of the over, Hasan Ali pounds it short and into the body, Chase fends it away behind square on the leg side. Was in the air for a good while but nobody there to take it. Single taken.
Cutter just outside off, takes off the surface a touch and hits high on the bat. Chase does well to keep it down.
Fuller in length again, outside off, Chase punches it towards cover-point. Wants the run but is sent back by his partner.
Chase squeezes this extremely full delivery outside off and plays it to covers.
Lands it on a back of a length, doesn't rise much as Chase defends it down off the back foot.
Length delivery in the off stump channel, Chase covers the line and lets it be.
Another one padded away. That'll be the end of the over.
The batsman offers no stroke and gets hit on the pad.
Turns off the rough, comes back in from outside leg, Hope meets the ball with his pads.
Tossed up outside leg, turns towards off as Hope pads it away.
Turning off the rough once more, Roston Chase goes back, opens the face and dabs it past first slip. Backward point moves to his left to collect it as a single is taken by the batsmen.
From around the wicket, drops it on the rough, spins sharply and it's kept out off the back foot.
Full again with a hint of inward movement once more, Hope comes ahead and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball on off, brings down a straight bat and works it on the on side.
Lovely inswinging delivery, coming back in sharply on off, Shai Hope just about manages to block it out in front of mid on.
Hurls it on a good length this time, Hope off his back foot punches it past the diving cover fielder. It's through as the batsmen take two runs.
Slightly ahead of a length, outside off, Shai Hope shuffles across and punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Instantly goes full, seam up delivery from Hasan Ali, it's outside off as Hope drills it to cover-point.
Hasan Ali is brought into the attack for the first time today...
Stays perfectly behind to this one and sees the over out without any harm.
FOUR! Good shot, Yasir Shah won't mind it though. It's tossed up on middle and leg, Chase gets low and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Some good, slow turn for Yasir Shah, he floats it around off. Roston Chase plants his front foot forward, covers the line well and lets it be.
Spinning away from around off, Chase stays back and blocks.
Tossed up outside off, Hope moves across a long way as he works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and too full around off, Hope is forward in defense as he smothers the ball in its tracks.
On a bit of a shorter length, it's defended well off the back foot.
Good, short delivery from Amir. Almost fetches him a wicket. Banged in short and angling in, Chase awkwardly fends it away aerially. Falls just short of Asad Shafiq at gully. Pretty close, that.
Takes some pace off this, pitches it full on off again, Chase is alert to this as he defends it with a straight blade.
Spears it in full and aiming the base of off stump, Roston from deep within his crease pushes it down to mid on.
Straightening up outside off, Chase leaves it alone.
Starts off from around the wicket and fires in a full delivery on middle and off, it straightens up just a touch as Roston Chase pushes it to mid off.
Flat, short and outside off, Hope goes across and half-pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off. No run taken.
Lands this on a shorter length, outside off, punched away for nothing.
Spinning away from a length around off, Hope is a bit cramped for room as he looks to cut. Gets a bottom edge which falls down beside him.
Tossed right up there on off, Shai Hope with a big lunge forward defends it down.
Drinks!
Amir really bends his back as he fires this one full around off, straightens up after hitting the deck and Roston Chase deals with it well.
Around the wicket now, short delivery angling in, defended well off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery around off, Roston rises on his toes and keeps it down.
Bumper from Amir, going across Roston Chase, he doesn't have anything to do with that.
Short of a length delivery into the body, Chase gets a bottom edge as he looks to pull. It falls well short of the short leg fielder before going into his hands.
Good length delivery slanting across, Chase pushes it to the covers from within the crease.
Flatter one on the stumps, Shai covers the line and keeps it out off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Hope drives it towards the cover region.
Turns away from a length, Hope looks to poke at it but is beaten all ends up.
Bowls a flipper around middle, Chase looks to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge past short leg. A single taken.
Quicker through the air around middle, Chase has no harm to dig this one out.
Around middle, and it rises off the deck, Hope fends it awkwardly behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and curling back in, Chase keeps it out gently. A brilliant over from Amir.
Roston Chase walks in next. It wouldn't be farfetched to say West Indies' hopes rest on him. He's going to have to provide something special here.

OUT! Off stump goes cartwheeling! A dream sight for any fast bowler to see the stumps getting uprooted. But not if you are Hetmyer. Hurls it on a driving length outside off, Shimron with no foot movement goes for a booming drive but the ball nips back in sharply, takes the inside edge and the off stump goes for a walk. Amir has his hands aloft, he's pumped up. Hetmyer bangs his bat on the pads as he starts to walk back. West Indies in early trouble again.
Fuller and angling in, Hetmyer prods forward and keeps it out.
In the channel outside off, Shimron lifts his bat to let it be.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Hetmyer stays back and pushes it towards the cover region.
On middle and off, milked down to long on for one.

Another top edge! Shah pulls the length back and Hope decides to go after it. The ball turns away with extra bounce and takes the top edge which lobs over the keeper. Younis from first slip chases after the ball. Three runs taken.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended into the ground.
FOUR! Full toss and it's put away! A loopy full toss outside off, Hope leans into it and drills it through extra cover for a boundary. No need to run for those.
Once again gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.

In the air... safe! Tossed up delivery outside off, turning in as Hetmyer gets down to sweep but gets a big top edge. It's in the air for a while but it falls down safely near the deep backward square leg region as Hasan Ali couldn't reach to it. Two runs taken.
Angles it away outside off, Hope gets across and leaves it alone.
Fuller in length and curls in a bit, pushed towards mid off.
Wide! Bangs in a short delivery on middle, it's kicks off the deck, Hope ducks under it.
Good length delivery outside off, Hope shoulders his arms.
Fuller and angling on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Deft! On a length and just outside off, Hetmyer waits for the ball and then at the last moment opens the face of the bat and guides it past first slip for a boundary towards third man.
Comes from over the wicket and hurls it on a length, angling in, Hetmyer defends it with a straight blade.
Mohammad Amir is into the attack.
Quicker through the air around middle and off, it's kept out gently.
The top spinner from Yasir, it dips in as Hope comes forward to play for the turn. But the ball goes straight, Hope gets an inside edge on the pads and the ball dies down.
Gives it a decent flight outside off, Hope pushes it towards the cover region.
Floats it up outside off, Shai comes forward and shoulders his arms.
Floats it up further outside off, Hope winds up for a slog sweep but the ball turns away and he leaves it alone.
Tossed up outside off, Hope lunges forward and defends it down on the pitch.
Bouncer to end the over. Hetmyer lets it sail over him.
Full and slow, outside off, easily kept out by leaping away.
Fires it full and outside off, blocked.
Cramps the southpaw for room and angles it in on off, Shimron punches it away in front of cover-point.
On a back of a length, well outside off, Hetmyer cuts it straight to cover-point.
Back of a length ball well outside off, no shot offered on that occasion.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Short, spinning away from outside off, easily pushed away.
A bit too full, it's drilled towards mid on. No run taken.
FOUR! Wonderfully placed. On the shorter side once more, Shai Hope gets back in a jiffy and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Beaten! Similar to the previous delivery, it's pushed quicker this time however. Hope goes back to cut but fails to make connection.
Over the wicket, Shah bowls a leg break on a length on off, Hope goes back and plays it down right under his nose.

FOUR! Shot. A complete contrast to the last delivery. If he was rock solid, now he's sharp like a knife. He comes ahead and with a nice swing, he drives it on the up to carve the gap in the covers. A boundary to end the over.
Comes from around the wicket, angles in a length delivery from around off, Hetmyer is rock solid in defense.
On a length once more, on off, Hetmyer stays put and taps it down on the off side with soft hands.
Pitches this on a length, keeps the line very tight and doesn't give Hetmyer much room to do much. He can only defends it back down the track.
Fractionally too straight, it's worked down on the on side by the left-hander.
Back of a length very close to the off stick, Shimron stands tall and punches it straight back. Mid off comes to his left and cuts it off.
Looped up delivery outside off, confidently kept out with a big stride forward.
From over the wicket now, it's full and on off, going away, Hope comes ahead and negotiates the spin well.
Shai Hope walks in at No.4.

OUT! Oh, Kraigg Brathwaite, what have you done? That's a such poor shot. Basically sums up how his series has gone, ends it on a not so positive note too. Yasir continues from around the wicket and drops this on a length, spins towards off and well away from the batsman. Brathwaite goes back and with an angled bat, lofts it to point. Hasan Ali is the man there and he dives forward to take a relatively easy catch.
That was close. Could have been easily gone. Hetmyer comes forward and flicks it uppishly past the short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Looped up beautifully around off, Hetmyer prods forward to get to the pitch and blocks.
Lands this on a length outside off, spins in as Hetmyer rocks back to this one. Punches it a bit square to point and takes two.
Kraigg Brathwaite pushes this one towards covers and ends the over rather solidly.
Slower fuller ball around off, Brathwaite picks it up, waits for it to come to him and defends it well.
Good length delivery outside off, walks across to this one and punches it back down towards mid on.
Short one pounded in on middle, Kraigg ducks and lets it sail over him.
Good length delivery just outside off, Brathwaite stays put and taps it down in front of covers.
Fuller length delivery on off, Kraigg brings down a straight bat and blocks it back down the track.
FOUR! Good, attacking intent from Shimron Hetmyer. He gives the charge to this tossed up delivery and smokes it over mid on. It falls just inside the rope and he'll pick up a boundary.
A lot of flight as it's dropped on a length, kept out off the back foot down on the turf.
Turning in from a length, Shimron backs away and punches it through extra cover. The fielder from mid off cuts it off as the batsmen take two.
Turn and bounce. Kicks off the deck, spins in off the rough and almost takes Hetmyer by surprise. He still somehow manages to work it down before FSL.
Short and spinning towards off around off, Brathwaite goes back and tucks it past the leg slip fielder for a run.
Continues from around the wicket and loops up a leg spinner outside leg, it's spinning as Kraigg Brathwaite pads it away.
Full and slow from Abbas, Hetmyer picks it up quickly and defends it down into the track. Comfortably done.
Coming back in, worked away to mid-wicket for one more.
Length ball shaping across Shimron Hetmyer, he pushes this away to the covers off his back foot and picks up a quick single.
That's a cracking shot. Full and wide outside off, Hetmyer reaches out to it and drives it crisply through the covers. Beats the diving fielder and picks up two runs for it.
Quick run. Brathwaite stands his ground and taps it towards Yasir Shah at point. He runs to his right to collect it but can't do so. The batsmen cross over with ease.
Good length delivery quite close to the off stump, Brathwaite keeps it out off the front foot.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end.
Spinning in sharply from around off, Hetmyer goes back and works it away past the short leg fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up on off, Hetmyer presses forward and works it to mid-wicket.

Misbah and Younis come out with their teammates giving them a Guard Of Honour. Probably the third one they've got, but all well-deserved. The visiting team is in a huddle now. Some encouraging words from their skipper and now they spread out to take their place in the field. Kraigg Brathwaite and Shimron Hetmyer will start the day off with the bat for West Indies. Yasir Shah to take the ball first up and finish his remaining over from yesterday. There's a slip, a leg slip, a silly point and a short leg in place. Here we go...

West Indies have a daunting task ahead of them. They're going to need a Roston Chase special to survive this day. And he's going to need some solid support from his teammates. Some positive signs are that someone or the other has stepped up when required in this series. Today will be one of those days, when the hosts desperately need that. It's going to be a historic day one way or the other.

A day many cricketing fans, especially Pakistan fans, would have dreaded to bear witness to. Two legends, two of their finest ever, will bow out when this day has passed. The series is levelled at 1-1. There is a chance, a good chance for the tourists to win their first ever series in the Caribbean. With so much to play for, this would be the perfect way for Misbah and Younis to bid adieu.
... FINAL DAY, FIRST SESSION ...

The visitors are clear favorites to win this one but if West Indies come out with a solid mindset and grittiness tomorrow, they can sniff themselves a chance considering the surface which is as flat as a pancake. So, will we see Pakistan finally winning the first ever Test series in the Caribbean or will the hosts still make them wait? All your questions shall be answered, so do join us tomorrow to catch all the action from the final day. Until then, Adios! Cheers!

The hosts let the game slip away as the pair of Mohammad Amir and Yasir Shah added vital runs towards the end to take the lead in excess of 300 before handing over the willow to the Windies. The home side then almost saw off the brief tricky period but Yasir Shah on the last ball of the day removed Powell to draw the first blood and end the day on the right note for Pakistan.

An excitingly emotional day of Test cricket comes to an end! For the past three days, this Test was moving as slow as a turtle but suddenly it's picked up pace on the penultimate day. Firstly, Pakistan rattled up the hosts in the morning session and earned themselves a handy lead of 129 runs. West Indies didn't let them run away with the game as their bowlers kept chipping away at the wickets and two of those were the ones which we won't ever see ever again, Misbah-ul-Haq and Younis Khan!

OUT! "UNBELIEVABLE".... As Sarfraz Ahmed has been saying for the past few minutes. He wanted Yasir Shah to get one last over in before Stumps and we all can see why so. This really is unbelievable! The leggie tosses it up beautifully around off, Kieran Powell prods forward to defend and it goes straight towards silly point. Shan Masood is the man there and he takes it wonderfully well. Quickly dives low to his left and takes a one-handed stunner. Beautiful stuff! The visitors have got just what they wanted, a wicket before the end of the day. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 4!
Stays around the wicket to Kraigg Brathwaite, loops it on leg and it spins in sharply off the rough, just takes off and lobs off the gloves over the first slip fielder. Just a single taken.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up on off, Powell goes across and wrists it away to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length just outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite walks across to this one and taps it down on the track beside him.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes back to over the wicket, pitches it on a length around off, Brathwaite keeps it out from within his crease.
Outside off, again, punched away to covers for a single.
Changes the angle and comes from around the wicket, hurls it in the off stump corridor, Powell makes a confident leave.
Angling across Kieran Powell, he offers no stroke on that occasion.
On middle and leg, Brathwaite buries it into the track.
Flighted delivery from Yasir Shah, outside off on a full length, kept out off the front foot.
Short, spinning and outside off, Kraigg off his back foot punches it square past silly point.
Left alone. It's spinning away from the right-hander who does not have anything to do with that.
Too full on off, wristed down to mid on. Won't get any run for it.
Tossed up outside off, Kraigg drives it hard on the up right at the silly point fielder.
Bowls it slightly ahead of a length, around off, Powell with a lunge forward blocks it down on the off side.
Good, tight line. Nicely bowled on a back of a length, very close to the off stick, Powell moves inside the line, looks to defend but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Back of a length delivery around the off stump channel, Powell punches it straight to short extra cover off the back foot.
Almost took the edge with that one. Abbas makes this one go away late, Powell has a feel for it from inside the line as the ball whiskers past the edge.
Nice and full, swinging back in on off, Powell with a good stride forward drives it straight to mid off.
Darted across on a back of a length, Kieran Powell withdraws his bat and watches the ball go past him.
Similar to the previous ball, Kraigg Brathwaite sees the over out with the full face of the bat.
Goes back to this one, the ball kicks off the deck a bit, kept down off the back foot.
Served in the off stump channel, going away from the batsman who offers no shot.
Lands it fuller and it's turning, Kraigg ensures it doesn't do any harm.
Straighter one on middle and off, Kraigg goes back and dangerously punches it to covers. Close one, needs to be careful with that. Could have easily gone through and hit the stumps.
Loops it up outside off, turns away sharply as Brathwaite lets it be.
Yasir Shah comes on to bowl.
Pitches this on a fullish length, well outside off, Kieran has nothing to do with it.
Some movement in the air after going past the batsman, it's comfortable enough though for him to leave it alone.
Full and straight on the pads, easy enough for Powell to flick it through mid-wicket. Two fielders chase it down as the batsmen take a couple.
On a good length and in the off stump channel, another elegant leave from the left-hander.
Shaping away on an excellent length, around off, Kieran Powell plants his front foot forward, raises his bat skywards and lets it be.
Full and straight from Abbas, Kieran Powell takes a good stride forward and plays it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Abbas will to share the new ball with Amir.
Change of angle from Mohammad Amir, comes around the wicket for the last ball of the over, Brathwaite leaves it alone as it's well outside off.
Short of a length outside off, Kraigg rises on his toes and punches it along the ground in Misbah's direction.
On a good length, outside off, pushed tamely to Misbah-ul-Haq at short extra cover.
Slanting away on a good length, with an open face it's dabbed to point.
Fuller length delivery fired across, Brathwaite leans ahead and pushes it past short extra cover for a couple of runs.

Action straightaway! Swing instantly for Mohammad Amir. Fires it full and it's coming back in, Brathwaite flicks it to short leg who takes it. Pakistan think there's no bump and it's gone straight off the bat to the fielder. The umpire isn't sure and checks upstairs. Replays show there is a bump.
